templates.label: Building permits, multifamily (5+ units)
templates.description: New privately-owned housing units authorized by building permits in the selected metro metro area. Multifamily structures of 5 or more units. Annual count, from the US Census Bureau Building Permits Survey (spliced across the 2024 CBSA redefinition).

templates.label: Building permits, single-family
templates.description: New privately-owned housing units authorized by building permits in the selected metro metro area. Single-family (1-unit) structures only. Annual count, from the US Census Bureau Building Permits Survey (spliced across the 2024 CBSA redefinition).

templates.label: Building permits, total units
templates.description: New privately-owned housing units authorized by building permits in the selected metro metro area. All structure types (1-unit, 2-unit, 3-4 unit, 5+ unit). Annual count, from the US Census Bureau Building Permits Survey (spliced across the 2024 CBSA redefinition).

templates.label: People who moved in the last year
templates.description: People who moved in the selected metro. From the American Community Survey 5-year estimates (table B07003). Released annually.

templates.label: Total population (mobility-table denominator)
templates.description: Total population (mobility-table denominator) for the selected metro. From the American Community Survey 5-year estimates (table B07003). Released annually.

templates.label: home price index (FHFA)
templates.description: FHFA all-transactions House Price Index for the selected metro metro area. Repeat-sales index of single-family properties with conforming mortgages; not seasonally adjusted, quarterly. The public-domain federal substitute for the proprietary Case-Shiller index.

templates.label: Adults 25+ with bachelor's degree
templates.description: Adults 25+ with bachelor's degree for the selected metro. From the American Community Survey 5-year estimates (table B15003). Released annually.

templates.label: Adults 25+ with master's degree
templates.description: Adults 25+ with master's degree for the selected metro. From the American Community Survey 5-year estimates (table B15003). Released annually.

templates.label: People in poverty
templates.description: People in poverty for the selected metro metropolitan statistical area. From the American Community Survey 5-year estimates (table B17001). Released annually.

templates.label: Per-capita personal income
templates.description: Per-capita personal income for the selected metro metro area: total personal income divided by population, both summed from BEA component counties. Annual, CAINC1.

templates.label: Personal income
templates.description: Total personal income for the selected metro metro area, summed from BEA component-county data (BEA discontinued its standalone metro income tables in 2024). Annual, BEA Regional table CAINC1.

templates.label: nonfarm payroll employment
templates.description: Total nonfarm payroll employment for the selected metro. Monthly, seasonally adjusted. From BLS Current Employment Statistics (CES) state-and-area program.

templates.label: unemployment rate
templates.description: Headline unemployment rate for the selected metro. Monthly, not seasonally adjusted. From BLS Local Area Unemployment Statistics (LAUS).

templates.label: Transit ridership
templates.description: Monthly public-transit ridership (unlinked passenger trips, all modes) for the selected metro urbanized area, summed across the transit agencies the FTA National Transit Database assigns to that area, then keyed to CBSA 45060.

templates.label: consumer price index (all items)
templates.description: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U), all items, for the selected metro metropolitan area. Index level, not seasonally adjusted; the base period varies by metro, so compare via year-over-year percent change.

templates.label: Zillow Home Value Index
templates.description: Zillow Home Value Index (ZHVI), typical home value (35th–65th percentile band, single-family + condo, smoothed seasonally adjusted). Monthly back to January 2000.

templates.label: Zillow Observed Rent Index
templates.description: Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI), typical observed market-rate rent across a region, repeat-rent index weighted to the rental housing stock. Monthly back to January 2015.

templates.label: Adults 25+ with bachelor's degree
templates.description: Adults 25+ with bachelor's degree for the selected state (statewide). Aggregated from the 2 congressional-district series for this state (118th-Congress boundaries) via direct sum. Underlying source, American Community Survey 5-year estimates (table B15003), released annually.

templates.label: Adults 25+ with master's degree
templates.description: Adults 25+ with master's degree for the selected state (statewide). Aggregated from the 7 congressional-district series for this state (118th-Congress boundaries) via direct sum. Underlying source, American Community Survey 5-year estimates (table B15003), released annually.

templates.label: All causes death rate
templates.description: Age-adjusted death rate per 100,000 population from all causes for the selected state, by year. CDC / National Center for Health Statistics (Leading Causes of Death).

templates.label: Alzheimer's disease death rate
templates.description: Age-adjusted death rate per 100,000 population from alzheimer's disease for the selected state, by year. CDC / National Center for Health Statistics (Leading Causes of Death).

templates.label: Aquaculture water withdrawals
templates.description: Aquaculture water withdrawals for the selected state, 2015, in million gallons per day (Mgal/d). U.S. Geological Survey, Estimated Use of Water in the United States.

templates.label: Building permits
templates.description: New privately-owned housing units authorized by building permits in the selected state, monthly (not seasonally adjusted). From the Census Bureau's Building Permits Survey, via FRED, a leading indicator of residential construction.

templates.label: Business applications
templates.description: Total business applications in the selected state, monthly (seasonally adjusted). From the Census Bureau's Business Formation Statistics, via FRED, a high-frequency gauge of new-business creation.

templates.label: CLRD death rate
templates.description: Age-adjusted death rate per 100,000 population from clrd for the selected state, by year. CDC / National Center for Health Statistics (Leading Causes of Death).

templates.label: Cancer death rate
templates.description: Age-adjusted death rate per 100,000 population from cancer for the selected state, by year. CDC / National Center for Health Statistics (Leading Causes of Death).

templates.label: Civilian noninstitutionalized population (disability-table denominator)
templates.description: Civilian noninstitutionalized population (disability-table denominator) for the selected state (statewide). Aggregated from the 6 congressional-district series for this state (118th-Congress boundaries) via direct sum.

templates.label: Civilian veteran population (18+)
templates.description: Civilian veteran population (18+) for the selected state (statewide). Aggregated from the 38 congressional-district series for this state (118th-Congress boundaries) via direct sum. Underlying source, American Community Survey 5-year estimates (table B21001), released annually.

templates.label: Diabetes death rate
templates.description: Age-adjusted death rate per 100,000 population from diabetes for the selected state, by year. CDC / National Center for Health Statistics (Leading Causes of Death).

templates.label: Drug overdose death rate
templates.description: Age-adjusted death rate per 100,000 population from drug overdose (drug poisoning) for the selected state, by year. CDC / National Center for Health Statistics. Final data, 1999 through 2018; ICD-10 underlying-cause codes X40-X44, X60-X64, X85, Y10-Y14.

templates.label: Electricity price
templates.description: Average retail price of electricity (all sectors) in the selected state, annual, in cents per kilowatt-hour. From the U.S. Energy Information Administration.

templates.label: Federal government employment in
templates.description: Federal civilian employees working in the selected state, monthly (BLS SAES). Includes the U.S. Postal Service, which is ~25% of total federal employment nationally. Public-domain BLS data via FRED.

templates.label: Federal spending in

templates.label: Foreign-born population

templates.label: Heart disease death rate

templates.label: Households with broadband internet

templates.label: Households with income $200k+
